en-US.name: My Dashboard
en-US.summary: A fast, custom touch dashboard for your Echo Show.
en-US.description: Shows a personal dashboard on your Echo Show: clock, weather, calendar agenda, touch tiles for smart home devices, a camera view and now-playing media. Built with Alexa Presentation Language (APL).
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my dashboard to refresh

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'open my dashboard' on an Echo Show. Tap a tile to toggle it.
